# NPH Studio
> Full-Stack Digital Product & AI Engineering Agency

NPH Studio is a founder-led digital engineering studio that designs, engineers, and deploys production-grade web applications, SaaS MVPs, and applied AI/RAG systems for high-growth startups and established businesses.

## Core Services
- [Full-Stack SaaS MVPs](https://www.nph-studio.in/services): Complete engineering from database architecture to cloud deployment within 3–5 weeks.
- [Applied AI & Custom RAG Pipelines](https://www.nph-studio.in/services): Enterprise retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector database integration (pgvector/Pinecone), and LLM agents.
- [High-Impact UI/UX & Web Presence](https://www.nph-studio.in/services): High-converting web applications with sub-second performance and 100/100 Core Web Vitals.
- [Dedicated Engineering Squad](https://www.nph-studio.in/services): Senior fractional engineering squads for continuous feature shipping.
